decisions.reason: Ownership and ordinary reuse of the editable Canva file do not establish the separately requested modular template system; message 51 leaves that system's engagement status unresolved.
The free-asset, ownership, editing-access, and reuse terms for the Canva source do not change the requirement to deliver a print-ready PDF.
The Canva source-file terms do not change the required document coverage, layout pass, formatting, or graphic treatment.
Message 51 confirms Agua Arc branding, but the source MODIFY concerns Canva asset access, ownership, and reuse and does not alter the branding state already established by message 49.
The Canva source-file ownership and asset restrictions do not change the requirement to incorporate supplied photos into the final draft.
Permission to edit and reuse the Canva file does not change which narrative content must be included in the current RFQ response.
The Canva source-deliverable terms do not alter the requirement to include the budget sheet and supplied proposal tables.
